Heavenly Idol gains a [10:minion_damage] damage, [10:minion_range] range, [Fire] attack
Adds the [Fire:fire] tag

upgrades.name: Bastion of Immortality
upgrades.desc:
Heavenly Idol can cast your Suspend Mortality on a 5 turn cooldown
Cannot target the Wizard

spells.name: Ice Phoenix
spells.desc: Summon an Ice Phoenix

upgrades.name: Freezing Attack
upgrades.desc: The Ice Phoenix's ranged attack [freezes] its target for 3 turns

upgrades.name: Reincarnations
upgrades.desc: The Ice Phoenix will reincarnate 3 additional times

upgrades.name: Restorative Phoenix
upgrades.desc: The Ice Phoenix can cast your Regeneration Aura on a 12 turn cooldown

upgrades.name: Polar Aura
upgrades.desc: The Ice Phoenix deals 2 [Ice] damage to enemies within [4:radius] tiles each turn

spells.name: Night Hag
spells.desc: Summon a Night Hag

upgrades.name: Spear Hag
upgrades.desc: The Night Hag can cast your Bone Spear on a 4 turn cooldown

upgrades.name: Hellbound
upgrades.desc: The Night Hag gains the [Demon] tag, and negates incoming damage from other [Demons:demon]

upgrades.name: Nightmare Hag
upgrades.desc:
The Night Hag can cast your Nightmare Aura on a 30 turn cooldown
Adds the [Arcane:arcane] tag

upgrades.name: Coven Matron
upgrades.desc:
Casting this spell also summons [2:num_summons] Witches near the Night Hag
These Witches will mature into Night Hags after 12 turns

spells.name: Orb of Anima
spells.desc:
Summon an Orb of Anima
Each turn, the Orb of Anima heals up to [2:num_targets] wounded allies in its line of sight
The Orb of Anima uses its own HP to heal its allies and will attempt to heal them to full health
Only one Orb of Anima may exist at a time
Casting this spell while an Orb of Anima exists will cause it to teleport to the selected location

upgrades.name: Blood Offerings
upgrades.desc: When you pay any amount of HP, the Orb of Anima heals for half that amount

upgrades.name: Anima Reclaimed
upgrades.desc: When a unit dies while adjacent to the Orb of Anima, it gains max HP and heals for half the slain unit's max HP

upgrades.name: Blood Thief
upgrades.desc: Each turn, the Orb of Anima drains [10:minion_damage] max HP from adjacent enemies, healing itself for the amount drained

upgrades.name: Anima's Vengeance
upgrades.desc: Units healed by the Orb of Anima gain [Bloodrage:blood] for a number of turns equal to the HP healed

spells.name: Orb of Assimilation
spells.desc:
Summon an Orb of Assimilation
When you manually cast a [Sorcery] spell targeting the Orb of Assimilation, it gains that spell on a 10 turn cooldown
Granting a spell in this way consumes its remaining charges, reducing the Orb's cooldown by 1 for each charge consumed
Only one Orb of Assimilation may exist at a time
Casting this spell while an Orb of Assimilation exists will cause it to teleport to the selected location

upgrades.name: Spell Sampling
upgrades.desc:
Granting the Orb of Assimilation a spell no longer drains its charges
Instead, the orb's cooldown for the spell will be set equal to the spell's level

upgrades.name: Damage Assimilation
upgrades.desc: When the Orb of Assimilation takes damage, it gains that much resistance to that damage type

upgrades.name: Assimilation Mastery
upgrades.desc: Each time the Orb of Assimilation casts a spell, it lowers the active cooldown of its other spells by 1

upgrades.name: Spell Exhaustion
upgrades.desc: Casting a [Sorcery] spell targeting the Orb of Assimilation grants you a permanent +10% bonus to that spell's [max charges:max_charges]

spells.name: Pillar of Fire
spells.desc:
Deal [50:damage] [Fire] damage in a [1:radius] tile burst
Deals double damage to the targeted tile

upgrades.name: Channeled Flame
upgrades.desc: You may channel Pillar of Fire for up to [12:max_channel] turns

upgrades.name: Disrupting Flames
upgrades.desc: Strips target of shields and applies -50 [Fire] resist for [10:duration] turns

upgrades.name: Pillar of Annihilation
upgrades.desc:
On kill, cast Annihilate on up to [4:num_targets] enemies in line of sight of the killed unit
Adds the [Chaos:chaos] tag

spells.name: Soul Tax
spells.desc:
Deal damage to the target equal to one third of its HP as [Holy] damage, and then one third of its remaining HP as [Dark] damage
Heals the caster for the damage dealt

upgrades.name: Insta Tax
upgrades.desc: Soul Tax gains quickcast

upgrades.name: Arcane Taxation
upgrades.desc:
Soul Tax deals an additional third of the target's remaining HP as [Arcane] damage
Adds the [Arcane:arcane] tag

upgrades.name: Soul Debt
upgrades.desc:
Soul Tax inflicts the [Soul Debt:blood] debuff
[Soul Debt:blood] redirects healing from the cursed unit to you
Adds the [Blood:blood] tag

upgrades.name: Mass Taxation
upgrades.desc: Affects a connected group of enemies

spells.name: Stonewake
spells.desc: Walls within [3:radius] tiles become floors, and are transformed into temporary Golems

upgrades.name: Return from Dust
upgrades.desc: Golems transform back into walls when they die

upgrades.name: Crystalline Core
upgrades.desc: Adjacent walls are transformed into Crystal Golems instead

upgrades.name: Orb Guardians
upgrades.desc:
When you cast Stonewake, your [Orb] allies also cast your Stonewake
Adds the [Orb:orb] tag

upgrades.name: Supremacy of Stone
upgrades.desc: After the initial burst, every wall in your line of sight is also transformed into a Golem

spells.name: Teleport
spells.desc: Teleport to target tile

upgrades.name: Group Teleport
upgrades.desc: Also teleports up to [10:num_targets] allies to locations near the destination

upgrades.name: Quickcast
upgrades.desc: Teleport gains quickcast

upgrades.name: Assassinate
upgrades.desc: If you Teleport adjacent to an enemy who could not see your original location, attempt to assassinate them, inflicting [60:damage] [Arcane] damage and [3:duration] turns of [silence]

upgrades.name: Void Teleport
upgrades.desc: Teleport deals [Arcane] damage to enemies in line of sight of the destination equal to its [max charges:max_charges]

spells.name: Temporal Transfusion
spells.desc: Each turn you channel this spell, the target unit takes 3 extra turns

upgrades.name: Chrono Boost
upgrades.desc: For each turn spent channeling, reduce the target's active spell cooldowns by 1

upgrades.name: Temporal Mastery
upgrades.desc: The target takes [4:num_targets] extra turns instead of 3

upgrades.name: Killing Tempo
upgrades.desc: If the target of your Temporal Transfusion kills a unit, they immediately take an extra turn

upgrades.name: Ritual of Haste
upgrades.desc:
If you complete the ritual, the target gains [Haste:translocation]
Adds the [Ritual:ritual] tag

spells.name: Arc Lightning
spells.desc:
Lightning arcs to [4:num_targets] enemies in line of sight of the target tile
Each arc deals [32:damage] [Lightning] damage in a beam
Then, this process repeats once for half damage, originating from each arc target

upgrades.name: Invigoration
upgrades.desc: Arc Lightning heals allies instead of damaging them

upgrades.name: Proton Storm
upgrades.desc:
Arc Lightning deals [4:damage] [Arcane] damage to units in line of sight of each arc target
Adds the [Arcane:arcane] tag

upgrades.name: Arc Welder
upgrades.desc:
When Arc Lightning begins at or arcs to a unit, cast Immolate on them
If it's a [Metallic] unit, also cast Magnetize on it
Adds the [Fire:fire] tag
Adds the [Metallic:metallic] tag

spells.name: Black Hole
spells.desc: Enemies in line of sight of the target are teleported as close as they can be toward it

upgrades.name: Singularity Crush
upgrades.desc: Deal [300:damage] [Physical] damage to the unit at the target tile after units have been teleported

upgrades.name: Heat Death
upgrades.desc:
Enemies within [2:radius] tiles of the target are [frozen] for [3:duration] turns
Adds the [Ice:ice] tag

upgrades.name: Environmental Destruction
upgrades.desc:
Black Hole first casts Earthquake centered on the target before teleporting
Adds the [Nature:nature] tag

spells.name: Demonic Ritual
spells.desc:
Summon a powerful [fiend:demon] with the [Ritual Bound:ritual] buff
If the ritual is interrupted or [Ritual Bound:ritual] is removed before the ritual is complete, the [fiend:demon] joins the enemy team before disappearing [6:max_channel] turns later

upgrades.name: Solomon's Binding
upgrades.desc:
Enemy [Demons:demon] are [stunned] for [3:duration] turns each turn you channel this spell
Adds the [Word:word] tag

upgrades.name: Inviolate Ritual
upgrades.desc: Gain 100% resistance to all damage types while channeling Demonic Ritual

upgrades.name: The Gate and the Key
upgrades.desc:
Once per Rift, if you complete the ritual while standing atop it, an allied [fiend:demon] will come forth from that location every 6 turns until the realm is complete
Adds the [Translocation:translocation] tag

upgrades.name: Grand Ritual
upgrades.desc: Rather than a single [fiend:demon], summon one of each

spells.name: Faehaunt Garden
spells.desc:
For every [50:minion_health] [Lightning] or [Arcane] damage you deal, summon a Butterfly Demon
Lasts [9:duration] turns

upgrades.name: Garden Pruning
upgrades.desc: Damage dealt to allies counts double towards summoning Butterflies

upgrades.name: Guardian Gnomes
upgrades.desc: Summon [4:num_summons] Gnomes on casting Faehaunt Garden

upgrades.name: Glass Garden
upgrades.desc: Summon Glass Butterflies instead of Butterfly Demons

upgrades.desc: Every 3rd Butterfly summoned has its Arcane Beam replaced with your Void Beam and its Lightning Beam replaced with your Lightning Bolt

spells.name: Furnace of Sorcery
spells.desc: Summon a Furnace of Sorcery which summons Furnace Hounds for every 100 damage dealt by [Sorcery] spells and equipment

upgrades.name: Flames of Sorcery
upgrades.desc: The furnace can cast your Flame Burst on a 5 turn cooldown

upgrades.name: Furnace of Purity
upgrades.desc:
[Holy] and [Fire] damage count double
Adds the [Holy:holy] tag

upgrades.desc:
The furnace also summons a Furnace Imp for every 50 damage dealt
Adds the [Dark:dark] tag

upgrades.name: Arcane Eyebolts
upgrades.desc:
Furnace Hounds can cast your Magic Missile on a 4 turn cooldown
Adds the [Arcane:arcane] tag

spells.name: Gold Drake
spells.desc: Summon a Gold Drake

upgrades.desc:
If you cast this spell targeting a Component or a Memory Orb, it is added to your inventory as though you had picked it up
If it was a Component with an On Pickup effect, that effect is also applied to the drake

upgrades.name: Immortal Dragon
upgrades.desc: Gold Drake will reincarnate 3 times

upgrades.desc: Gold Drakes can cast your Healing Light on an 8 turn cooldown

upgrades.desc: Gold Drake deals [14:minion_damage] [Holy] damage to enemies that damage it

upgrades.desc: Heaven's Wrath also [stuns] affected units for [3:duration] turns

upgrades.name: Fiery Wrath
upgrades.desc:
Heaven's Wrath also deals [Fire] damage
Adds the [Fire:fire] tag

upgrades.name: Culling
upgrades.desc: Heaven's Wrath also damages the units with the lowest current HP

upgrades.name: Heaven's Promise
upgrades.desc:
Cast Seal Fate on units which survive the damage from Heaven's Wrath
Adds the [Dark:dark] tag

spells.name: Knightly Oath
spells.desc:
Summon a either a void knight, a storm knight, a chaos knight, or a blood knight
The summoned knight will match the spell school you have spent the most SP on
Void Knight: [Arcane]
Storm Knight: [Lightning] or [Ice]
Chaos Knight: [Chaos]
Blood Knight: [Blood]
The caster takes [40 Holy:holy] damage when a knight dies

upgrades.name: Ouranic Knights

upgrades.name: Call to Arms

When you cast Knightly Oath, cast Armageddon Blade on the summoned Knight

Knights gain the [Slime] tag and the Slime buff, healing over time, gaining max HP until it is double the original before splitting in two
Adds the [Slime:slime] tag

Create an expanding area of miasma in a [3:radius] tile burst at the target location
Enemies in affected tiles take [10:damage] [Poison] damage and are afflicted with [blind], [silence], and [poison] for [8:duration] turns
Each turn spent channeling increases the radius of the affected area by 1

upgrades.name: Consumptive Vapors
upgrades.desc: Miasma also inflicts [necrosis] and [bleed]

upgrades.name: Ritual of Suffocation
upgrades.desc:
If the channel is completed, all [poisoned] enemies on the level take [30:damage] [Dark] and [Poison] damage
Adds the [Ritual:ritual] tag

upgrades.name: Rapid Growth
upgrades.desc: Miasma's radius expands twice as fast

upgrades.name: Plague Bringer
upgrades.desc: Cast Rot Gaze for free each turn you channel Miasma

spells.desc:
Deal [10:damage] [Holy] damage in a beam
If the beam encounters a [frozen] unit, it refracts, creating up to [4:num_targets] more beams which shoot from that unit toward enemies in line of sight of it

upgrades.name: Arcane Refraction

Prismatic Beam also refracts when it encounters [petrified] or [glassed] units
Adds the [Arcane:arcane] tag

upgrades.desc: When the beam refracts, it deals [Ice] damage in a [2:radius] tile burst centered on the [frozen] unit

upgrades.name: Softened Light
upgrades.desc: Prismatic Beam heals allies instead of damaging them

upgrades.name: Prismatic Pulse
upgrades.desc: The beam is instead a wide pulse which also impacts tiles adjacent to the center beam

spells.name: Ritual of Flying Daggers
spells.desc:
Each turn, ready [6:num_targets] daggers
When you stop channeling, the daggers are unleashed, each dealing [9:damage] [Physical] damage to an enemy in your line of sight
If the ritual is completed, the number of daggers is multiplied by [6:num_targets]
Daggers Ready: 0

An additional dagger is also fired from each of your [Nature] allies
Adds the [Nature:nature] tag

upgrades.name: Soul Blades

Sanction the target
Sanction deals [30:damage] [Holy] damage to the cursed unit when they cast a spell or take [Holy] damage from another source
You are healed for 1 HP when Sanction deals damage

upgrades.name: Divine Rebuke
upgrades.desc: Each turn, cast Sanction on the first unsanctioned enemy that damages you

upgrades.name: Exiled One
upgrades.desc: Sanctioned units are [berserked] for [5:duration] turns

upgrades.name: Mass Sanction
upgrades.desc: Sanction affects up to [4:num_targets] enemies in a connected group

upgrades.name: Stripped Bare
upgrades.desc: Sanction reduces all resistances to 0

spells.name: Twilight Gaze

Enemies in your line of sight lose 50 [Dark] and [Holy] resist

upgrades.name: Arcane Gaze

Transform into a flying [Demon]
Each turn, your other [Chaos] spells regain 1 charge
Gain [100 Dark:dark], [50 Physical:physical], [50 Fire:fire], and [50 Lightning:lightning] resistance
Lasts [12:duration] turns

upgrades.desc:
When an enemy is slain by [Fire], [Lightning], or [Physical] damage, summon a Chaos Imp at their location
Adds the [Conjuration:conjuration] tag

While in Demon Form, when another unit takes [Dark] damage they lose 1 max HP and you heal 1 HP
If your health is already full, gain 1 [SH:shields] instead

upgrades.desc: Casting Demon Form first casts your other self-targeted [Enchantment] spells

upgrades.name: Demonic Royalty
upgrades.desc: When you cast this spell, [Demons:demon] in your line of sight with less HP than you join your team

spells.name: Multicast

When you manually cast a [Sorcery] spell, cast it again for free

upgrades.desc:
When you cast this spell, one of your [Sorcery] spells is selected at random
Until the end of the level, manually casting that spell will cast it again for free
This is independent of and stacks with the normal Multicast buff

upgrades.name: Preparedness
upgrades.desc: Cast Multicast at the beginning of each level

spells.desc:
Cast Thunder Strike targeting up to [12:num_targets] [Storm Clouds:lightning] each turn
Clouds with enemies in them are prioritized
Will not target the caster or their allies
This spell can be channeled for up to [12:max_channel] turns

upgrades.name: Cryostorm
upgrades.desc:
Rain of Thunderbolts may also target [Blizzards:ice] or [Rain Clouds:nature], but casts Iceball on them instead of Thunder Strike
Adds the [Ice:ice] tag

upgrades.name: Stormbringer
upgrades.desc: Each turn you channel, summon [12:num_targets] [Storm Clouds:lightning] at random locations

upgrades.name: Tempest Drakes

Each strike has a 20% chance of casting your Storm Drake spell

Each turn, your [Eye] buffs activate [3:num_targets] additional times

upgrades.name: Eternal Vigil
upgrades.desc: Activations from the ritual will not decrease the [Eye] buffs' remaining duration

upgrades.name: Unseen Dreamers

When you begin the ritual, enemies outside your line of sight are put to [sleep] for [8:max_channel] turns
If you fail to complete the ritual, all [sleeping:sleep] units wake up

upgrades.name: Rapturous Sight
upgrades.desc: If you complete the ritual, cast your other self-targeted [Eye] spells

upgrades.name: Waking The Witness
upgrades.desc:
If an enemy dies in your line of sight while channeling the ritual, cast Floating Eye at their location
Adds the [Dark] tag

spells.name: Soul Wind
spells.desc:
Deal [37:damage] [Dark] damage in a 3 tile wide line perpendicular to the caster
[Undead], [Dark], and [Demon] units in the area take [Holy] damage instead of [Dark]
Summon a Ghost near each [Living] unit in the affected area

upgrades.name: Dual Wind
upgrades.desc: Soul Wind also affects a symmetric area behind the caster

upgrades.name: Arcane Wind
upgrades.desc:
Soul Wind also deals [Arcane] damage
Adds the [Arcane:arcane] tag

upgrades.name: Soul Death
upgrades.desc: Summon Death instead of a Ghost

upgrades.name: Shared Soul
upgrades.desc: Enemies that share a name with a unit slain by Soul Wind are afflicted with Shared Pain for [9:duration] turns

upgrades.desc: The spawners' summoning spell cooldown is halved

Create a [7 tile:radius] line of flames perpendicular to the caster
The flames deal [30:damage] [Fire] damage in the affected tiles each turn
Only a single Wall of Flame can be maintained at a time
Casting the spell again removes the previous wall
Lasts [8:duration] turns

upgrades.name: Feed the Flames
upgrades.desc: Wall of Flames' remaining duration increases by 1 when it kills a unit

upgrades.name: Thickened Wall
upgrades.desc: Wall of Flame is now 3 tiles thick instead of a line

upgrades.name: Fortress of Flame
upgrades.desc: Affects tiles in lines rotated around the caster, forming a square

upgrades.name: Flames of Heaven
upgrades.desc:
When you cast Wall of Flame, cast Pillar of Fire on each affected tile
Adds the [Holy:holy] tag

upgrades.name: Incubation Exposure
upgrades.desc: When one of your wyrm eggs is killed, the wyrm it spawns gains 100% resistance to the damage type that killed it

upgrades.name: Magic Eggs
upgrades.desc:
Fire eggs can cast your Fireball on a 3 turn cooldown
Ice eggs can cast your Icicle on a 3 turn cooldown

upgrades.name: Scale Harvest
upgrades.desc: For every 6 [Dragon] allies that die, regain a charge of Wyrm Eggs

upgrades.name: Radiant Eggs
upgrades.desc:
Wyrm Eggs gain a damaging aura with a [3:radius] tile radius
The aura deals [1:damage] [Fire] or [Ice] damage to match the egg's type

spells.name: Dream the Starwhale
spells.desc:
Summon a Starwhale
Gain 100% [Ice] and [Arcane] resistance while channeling
The Starwhale is unsummoned and you are [frozen] for 3 turns when you stop channeling
Can be channeled for up to [12 turns:max_channel]

upgrades.name: Starbask
upgrades.desc: While channeling, you and the Starwhale heal for half of any [Arcane] damage dealt

upgrades.name: Ice Dream
upgrades.desc: Starwhale's aura [freezes] affected enemies for [2:duration] turns

upgrades.name: Shatterstar
upgrades.desc: The Starwhale gains burrowing

upgrades.name: Ritual of Stars
upgrades.desc:
If you complete the ritual, the Starwhale is not unsummoned, and you are not [frozen]
Adds the [Ritual:ritual] tag

spells.name: Horde of Halfmen
spells.desc: Summon [3:num_summons] Satyrs and [3:num_summons] Minotaurs

upgrades.name: Baphomet's Horde
upgrades.desc:

Deal [7:damage] [Arcane] or [Lightning] damage to the nearest [1:num_targets] enemies each turn
